decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - BRS.2271.01-1a, ES1, ES2, ES3, S1, S2, A5, A1.1 and A1.2 received 09.06.11, A2, A3 and A4 received 19.07.11, A1.0 received 05.09.11, A6 received 04.10.11, 110222 E700 TDv1 received 28.09.11, Cover Letter ref 17/3625 prepared by Planning Potential dated 17/05/2017, Noise Impact Assessment ref. 17204/001/js prepared by Applied Acoustic Design dated 11/05/2017. Received on 17/05/2017
Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted for A2 purposes shall not be carried on
outside the following times 7am - 10pm Monday to Saturday, 10am - 6pm on Sundays and Public Holidays and shall not be open for trading on Christmas Day, New Years Day and Easter Sunday.
Condition : 3 - Servicing of the use hereby approved shall not take place outside the
following times 8am - 8pm Monday - Friday, 8am - 6pm on Saturdays and 11am - 5pm on Sundays.
Condition : 4 - The rating level of noise emitted from this site, shall be lower than the
existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be
determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The
measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997
Condition : 5 - The illumination levels of the signage shall not exceed 600cd/m
Condition : 6 - The glazing on the west elevation of the building shall be non-reflective
glazing and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with non-reflective glazing.
Condition : 7 - The air conditioning units and other plant contained on the roof shall be turned off outside the following times 7am-10pm Monday - Saturday, 10am-6pm on Sundays and Public Holidays and shall be turned off on Christmas Day, New Years Day and Easter Sunday.
description: Variation of condition 11 and 18 of planning permission 00248/137/P1 dated 03/11/2011 to allow the store to operate between the hours of 7am-10pm Monday to Saturday, 10am to 6pm on Sundays and Public Holidays and shall not be open for trading on Christmas Day, New Years Day and Easter Sunday and the air conditioning units and other plant contained on the roof shall be turned off at all times when the store is not open to the public.
